name: cull_object_and_project_vertices
description: Rejects an object whose bounding words fail the range test, then scales its coordinate words, rotates them with a 3x3 matrix and passes the result to a drawing routine.

name: store_nearest_candidate_if_closer
description: Transforms a sampled point by a 3x3 matrix, rejects it when the cross-product flatness test fails, and records it as the new nearest candidate when its depth is smaller than the stored one.

name: store_nearest_candidate_record
description: Transforms the object's coordinate block by the current matrix and, when its depth value is below the stored best, copies the result fields and sets the candidate flag.

name: transform_vertex_triplet_by_matrix
description: Multiplies a three-component vector by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix to store three scaled results, then transforms a second vector and writes the matching record fields.

name: interpret_draw_command_stream
description: Walks a byte-coded command list, testing each entry's bit mask against a per-object flag word, and executes or skips the matching entries until a zero terminator.

name: resume_command_stream_decoding
description: Reads the next command byte, applies its flag bit and jumps into the shared command stream decoder loop.

name: decode_command_bit_entry
description: Tests one bit of the flag word against the current index and decodes the next stream entry when the bit is set, otherwise skipping to the loop body.

name: return_without_action
description: Single-instruction routine that only returns and leaves all state unchanged.

name: walk_command_stream_entries
description: Repeats the command stream decoding loop, reading entries until a zero terminator and applying each one through the shared object lookups.

name: shift_stack_entries_and_decode
description: Iterates the command stream while shifting a six-word buffer on the stack and copying the entries back into it.

name: lookup_object_bounds_for_command
description: Finds an object's table entry through the object offset table, computes its bounding words and fills a draw record used by the drawing routine.

name: call_one_routine_unresolved
description: Routine of 13 instructions that makes a single call; no decompiled body was available, so only its call relationship is known.

name: call_four_routines_unresolved
description: Routine of 41 instructions that makes four calls and is entered from two callers; no decompiled body was available, so only its call relationships are known.

name: call_three_routines_unresolved
description: Six-instruction routine that makes three calls and is entered from one caller; no decompiled body was available, so only its call relationships are known.

name: chain_three_calls_unresolved
description: Seven-instruction routine that makes three calls in sequence; no decompiled body was available, so only its call relationships are known.

name: scan_string_entries_in_range
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte list, converts each entry with a helper call and, when the value lies in the active range, stores three result words before continuing.

name: scan_entries_bounded_by_limits
description: Walks a zero-terminated list while the bounds check holds, calls a helper for each entry and records three result words when the value passes the lower bound.

name: scan_entries_until_bound
description: Walks a zero-terminated list, calls a helper for each entry and stores three result words when the value falls within the active bounds, skipping to the terminator when it leaves them.

name: store_result_and_scan_list
description: Stores three result words when the value is within the bound, then walks a zero-terminated list calling a helper for each entry.

name: perspective_divide_projected_coordinate
description: Looks up a vertex term, forms a fixed-point dot product with a matrix row and divides it by that row's denominator, packing quotient and remainder into one result; a zero denominator returns a saturated value.

name: project_point_with_perspective_divide
description: Looks up a coordinate, applies a sign and shift from a scaled difference, forms a dot product with a matrix row and divides by the row denominator; a zero denominator returns a saturated value.

name: project_delta_with_perspective_divide
description: Shifts three delta components when the zero flag is clear, subtracts the stored origin, forms a dot product with a matrix row and divides it by the row denominator, saturating on zero.

name: xor_word_with_high_half
description: XORs a 16-bit register with the upper word of its input and returns the result sign-extended and XORed with the mask 32767.

name: save_six_inputs_accumulate_total
description: Saves six 32-bit inputs into a state block, then adds an object's long value to the running total and computes a scaled fixed-point half-sum with a loop.

name: normalize_fixed_point_operands
description: Combines the operand words, counts the left shifts needed to normalize the largest value and shifts the saved state words by that count before the comparison step.

name: divide_32bit_fixed_point_values
description: Performs bit-serial long division of the saved 32-bit operands, shifting one bit at a time through the quotient and remainder words and storing the result in the state block.

name: compare_scaled_value_and_store
description: Scales an input by the stored exponent, compares the result with the saved accumulator and, when it is within range, computes a quotient through a shift loop and stores it with a status flag.

name: shift_and_store_quotient_status
description: Shifts an input by the stored exponent, compares it with the saved accumulator and, when it falls in range, computes a quotient by shifting and stores it with a status value.

name: store_normalized_operands_and_status
description: Shifts a 32-bit operand right until it fits a 14-bit range, stores it with the other operands and a status code in the state block and sets the pending flag.

name: copy_eight_longs_from_pointer
description: Waits until a flag word is zero, then copies eight longwords from the source pointer into a state block, copies one further word and clears a status byte.

name: call_then_copy_global_block
description: Calls one routine, then copies eight longwords from fixed global values into the state block, sets a fixed word and sets the status byte to non-zero.

name: copy_global_block_into_state
description: Copies eight longwords from fixed global values into the state block, sets a fixed word and sets the status byte to non-zero.

name: wait_for_two_flags_clear
description: Loops until a state flag word and a global flag longword are both zero, then returns.

name: copy_800_blocks_between_buffers
description: Copies 800 consecutive blocks of ten values from the buffer behind one global pointer to the buffer behind the other, then returns.

name: copy_strided_rows_between_buffers
description: Copies thirty-two rows of ten values between the two buffers, each row starting from a fixed offset within them.

name: store_inputs_and_set_status
description: Sets the status byte to non-zero and stores the eight input registers as longwords in the state block.

name: reset_status_and_wait_flags
description: Clears a status byte, waits for a flag word to clear, writes a fixed word and clears a second status byte, calls one routine and waits for the flag again.

name: store_word_in_two_slots
description: Stores a 16-bit input into two state words.

name: swap_buffer_pointers
description: Copies eight longwords of staged state into a second block, toggles a parity byte and swaps the two global buffer pointers; the routine also touches the copper list pointer register.

name: copy_buffer_pointer_to_slot
description: Stores the first global buffer pointer into a second global slot.

name: copy_second_pointer_to_slot
description: Stores the second global buffer pointer into the same global slot.

name: loop_forever_without_exit
description: Spins in an unconditional empty loop and never returns, with no data or hardware operations.

name: wait_counter_then_set_one
description: Waits until a global counter is not positive, then sets that counter to one.

name: wait_counter_then_set_two
description: Waits until a global counter is not positive, then sets that counter to two.

name: read_pending_byte_value
description: Returns a queued byte when a pending flag is set, clearing the flag and looking up the value through a small table selected by two configuration bytes; otherwise it returns zero.

name: clear_pending_and_return_byte
description: Clears the pending flag and returns the byte stored behind it.

name: queue_byte_and_set_pending
description: Stores the input byte in the queue slot and sets the pending flag to non-zero.

name: read_queued_byte_by_count
description: Returns the queued byte when a count byte is negative and zero when it is zero; otherwise it clears the pending flag and returns a table value selected by two configuration bytes.

name: clear_queue_count_byte
description: Clears the queue count byte.

name: setup_graphics_interrupts
description: Clears 32 state longwords, opens graphics.library, installs an interrupt server and sets the copper list pointer, DMA, interrupt enable, display and colour registers.

name: wait_then_call_library_vectors
description: Waits until a state flag word clears, sets a global value and calls two library vectors, one of which is the interrupt vector installer.

name: enable_interrupt_bit_then_call
description: Calls one library vector, writes a value with bit 15 set to the interrupt control register and calls a second library vector, storing its result; the routine touches the interrupt enable and request registers.

name: shutdown_graphics_and_interrupts
description: Disables interrupts and DMA by writing clear masks to the custom registers, removes the interrupt server, closes the library and calls one further routine.

name: copy_palette_after_beam_wait
description: Waits until the video position counter passes a threshold, copies eight stored values into the colour registers from the first colour register on, then writes an interrupt enable mask.

name: update_input_and_blit_state
description: When a pending flag is set, loads display and blitter parameter values from global state and clears the flag; it then calls subroutines that update counters and timers and read the mouse and button ports.

name: advance_step_counter_and_position
description: Decrements a step counter; while it stays non-zero it picks a value from a flag bit, shifts the flag, advances a position word by 8000 and writes these to the custom registers, otherwise it clears the counter and writes an interrupt enable mask.

name: advance_blit_position_and_enable
description: Halves a counter word, advances a 32-bit position by 8000, writes the position and a stored value to the blitter registers and writes an interrupt enable mask.

name: clear_flag_and_enable_interrupt
description: Clears a state flag word and writes an interrupt enable value with bit 15 and bit 6 set.

name: open_input_device
description: Stores the results of two library calls and, when a message port was allocated and the input device opens, sets the request command code and sends the request with the send-I/O call.

name: close_input_device
description: If an input request block exists, sets its command code, sends it and closes the device, then resets the object flags and calls one cleanup routine.

name: handle_input_event_by_type
description: Handles an input event by type: for type one it sets or clears a per-code flag from the masked code and updates the last-code bytes; type two does nothing and any other type is returned unchanged.

name: clear_input_event_fields
description: Clears three bytes and a word in the structure passed in the address register, then returns zero.

name: allocate_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a memory block, initializes a message port for the current task and signal, adds it to the system and returns it; on failure it frees the signal and returns zero.

name: free_message_port
description: If a message port pointer is non-null, calls a cleanup routine when a field is set, sets two status bytes to maximum, then removes the port, frees its signal and frees its memory.

name: set_default_position_pair
description: Sets a state word to zero and the following state word to 512.

name: store_position_pair
description: Stores two 16-bit inputs as a pair of state words.

name: read_position_pair
description: Returns the stored pair of 16-bit state words as one 64-bit value, with the first word in the upper half.

name: read_state_low_bits
description: Returns the low two bits of a state byte.

name: update_position_from_offsets
description: Advances a frame counter, adds stored offsets to two position words, stores the button byte and sets queue flags when the adjusted position passes its checks, then clears the count byte.

name: process_joystick_input
description: Reads the joystick port and fire button, decays two velocity words toward zero in steps of 300, applies joystick direction and stores the updated velocities with a status word.

name: set_status_word_minus_one
description: Sets a state word to minus one.

name: append_global_records_to_state
description: Sets a state word to minus one, scans to the end of the five-word record list in state, then copies five-word records from a global table into it until the terminator.

name: append_input_records_to_state
description: Scans to the end of the five-word record list in state, then copies five-word records from the input pointer into it, writing a minus-one marker after each copied record until the input list ends.

name: remove_matching_record_from_buffer
description: Searches the record list in state for an entry whose field equals the input value and, when found, shifts the following records back over it, keeping the minus-one terminator.

name: append_offset_record_clamped
description: Appends a five-word record at the end of the state list, storing an input-based marker, two offset coordinates and a clamped origin pair, and terminates the list with minus one.

name: append_record_with_second_offset
description: Appends a five-word record at the end of the state list using a second input offset from a different register, clamps the origin pair at zero and terminates the list with minus one.

name: initialize_offset_table_from_base
description: Writes values derived from the input at steps of 8000 into a block, storing each as word halves, and finishes by setting fixed constants.

name: initialize_state_and_run_loop
description: Clears several state fields, then runs an endless loop that calls subroutines and stores marker values in a stack slot on each pass.

name: store_input_and_clear_state
description: Stores the input word in a stack slot, clears several state fields, clears one flag bit in the state byte and calls routines through the table pointer.

name: run_frame_loop_with_counter
description: Runs a loop that starts a 35000-unit timer and calls eight routines from a dispatch table, storing a fixed marker value before each call.

name: initialize_and_run_main_loop
description: Clears three dispatch table pointers, calls about two dozen setup and service routines, waits on a status word, then repeats the service sequence forever.

name: format_signed_integer_string
description: Writes a signed 32-bit value into a string, adding a minus sign for negatives, extracting digits by subtracting decimal powers and ending with a zero byte.

name: convert_integer_to_decimal_string
description: Converts a 32-bit value into a ten-character decimal string by repeatedly subtracting powers of ten and storing each digit as an ASCII character, ending with a zero byte.

name: fill_block_by_tens
description: Stores two index bytes in state, calls two routines and loops over a block in steps of ten until a limit is reached, updating pointers in state.

name: format_value_as_nibble_chars
description: Writes a 32-bit value as eight characters, one per four-bit group from the top, using decimal-digit characters for values up to nine and a second character range above that, then ends with a zero byte.

name: read_edited_text_line
description: Reads keyboard characters into a line buffer, handling backspace and delete codes, echoing each accepted character through a helper and stopping at the length limit.

name: edit_text_line_buffer
description: Stores typed characters into a text buffer, removing the previous character on delete or backspace codes and echoing each change through helper calls.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: parse_signed_decimal_text
description: Parses an optional minus sign and decimal digits from a text pointer into a signed integer, advancing the pointer past the digits.

name: skip_decimal_digits
description: Advances a text pointer past consecutive decimal digit characters and stops at the first non-digit.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns; no other work is visible in the decompiled body.

name: store_cross_product_components
description: Stores three input vector components into a structure, then computes cross-product components from the stored values and writes them back into the structure.

name: return_constant_two
description: Returns the constant two with no other effect.

name: return_constant_three
description: Returns the constant three with no other effect.

name: return_constant_four
description: Returns the constant four with no other effect.

name: return_constant_five
description: Returns the constant five with no other effect.

name: select_tier_from_threshold
description: Compares an input value against descending thresholds and returns a tier number paired with a fixed value for the band it falls in.

name: update_object_motion_state
description: Chooses a damping shift from a state value, clamps an input scale to a maximum, and adds scaled velocity components into the object's position and velocity fields.

name: damp_velocity_component
description: Reduces a signed velocity field toward zero using a shift chosen from a helper result, and when its magnitude exceeds fourteen adds a helper-computed increment to the field.

name: damp_axis_velocity_on_input
description: Compares a signed velocity input against fourteen; when its magnitude exceeds that, adds a helper result to a stored field and applies shift-based decay to two velocity fields.

name: damp_velocity_with_neighbour_update
description: Reduces a signed velocity field, when its magnitude exceeds fourteen, through a helper call and updates the related field pair with shift-based decay.

name: update_field_from_velocity
description: Checks a signed field and, when its magnitude exceeds fourteen, adds a helper increment to the neighbouring field, and sets a byte to sixty when a byte comparison fails.

name: damp_axis_velocity_from_state
description: Compares a signed velocity value against fourteen; when exceeded, adds a helper result to a field and applies shift-based decay to two fields, setting a byte to sixty when a comparison fails.

name: update_grouped_fields_from_velocity
description: Checks a signed field and, when its magnitude exceeds fourteen, adds a helper increment to a neighbouring field, applies shift-based decay to a field group and sets a byte to sixty when a byte comparison fails.

name: return_without_effect
description: Single return that leaves all state unchanged.

name: damp_axis_velocity_on_fields
description: Compares a signed input against a limit of fourteen and, when exceeded, adds a helper result to a field and applies shift-based decay to a field group, setting a byte to sixty when a comparison fails.

name: skip_without_effect
description: Single return with no effect on state.

name: shift_velocity_fields_into_offsets
description: Stores one field shifted right by three bits and a second field shifted right by two bits and negated, each into a separate offset of the same structure.

name: compute_dot_products_clamped
description: Computes three dot products from stored vector components into structure fields and conditionally clamps the first two results to plus or minus 16384 according to the sign of the third.

name: compute_dot_products_inverted
description: Computes three dot products from stored vector components into structure fields and, when the third is non-negative, inverts the first two results with a shift and an XOR mask of 16383.

name: compute_global_vector_dot
description: Computes a dot product between three local vector components and a global vector, scales it and stores the negated result in the structure.

name: update_fields_from_matching_state
description: Compares a state byte with a matching byte in the second structure; when they match and a flag is set it halves stored fields, otherwise it stores scaled dot products of the two structures' components.

name: compute_pair_dot_or_halve
description: When a flag byte is clear, computes dot products between the structure's vector components and the second structure's rows and stores them in fields; otherwise it halves a few fields.

name: compute_matrix_rows_dot_fields
description: Computes dot products of the structure's vector components with the second structure's rows, storing the scaled results in fields, and writes a third result when the flag word is non-zero.

name: normalize_signed_pair_products
description: Takes one's complement of negative operands, scales the high and low halves of a pair of values by shifts, and returns them as a 64-bit pair.

name: shift_signed_operand_pairs
description: Takes one's complement of negative operands, combines them with OR and scales two input pairs right by a computed shift, returning the result as a 64-bit pair.

name: shift_pair_until_under_limit
description: Counts the right shifts needed to reduce a value to 16383 or less, then shifts two input values right by that count and returns them as a 64-bit pair.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines in succession and returns; no other memory or register work is visible.

name: combine_flagged_fields_by_product
description: Calls helpers for two values and, when the first structure's flag byte is set and the second's is clear, multiplies structure fields by a helper value and returns the combined pair.

name: add_scaled_offsets_to_pair
description: Obtains a 64-bit value from a helper, adds two scaled 16-bit fields from a structure to its high and low halves and returns the pair.

name: subtract_offsets_or_negate_pair
description: When a flag byte differs from one structure and matches the other, calls a helper and subtracts two stored offsets from its result; otherwise it returns the two stored offsets negated.

name: negate_pair_of_ints
description: Reads two 32-bit values from the structure at fixed offsets, negates them and returns them as a 64-bit pair.

name: select_pair_by_type_flag
description: Returns a stored 64-bit pair unless a type byte equals one; for type one with a flag bit clear it calls a vector and returns the scaled differences of two fields, otherwise zero.

name: compute_scaled_position_delta
description: When a flag bit is clear, calls a routine that zeroes three values, calls a vector with the stored fields and returns the scaled differences of two fields; otherwise it returns zero.

name: rescale_absolute_pair_values
description: Takes absolute values of a 64-bit pair and an input operand, combines their bits, then calls helpers to rescale the pair from the structure's fields.

name: normalize_and_accumulate_triplet
description: Shifts a three-value operand left until its high bit reaches the 8192 threshold, shifts the three inputs by the same count and accumulates the scaled values into the structure with carry.

name: adjust_word_inputs_with_structure
description: Reads a stored word from the structure, adjusts it with two word inputs and returns the result after helper calls, with a flag-controlled branch.

name: rescale_magnitude_pair_with_shift
description: Takes absolute values of a 64-bit pair and a second operand, selects a shift from their combined bits and rescales the structure's position fields with helper calls.

name: normalize_and_store_position_result
description: Normalizes the first operand by doubling until it reaches the 8192 threshold, shifts the other inputs by the same count and stores the computed position values into the structure through helper calls.

name: apply_shifted_deltas_to_position
description: Adds three input words to stored deltas shifted by a count, clamps a shift count to twelve and returns the adjusted values shifted accordingly as a 64-bit pair.

name: shift_and_combine_words
description: Right-shifts two input values by a variable count and returns them packed as one 64-bit result.

name: forward_call_unresolved
description: Two-instruction routine that makes one call and is entered from one caller; no decompiled body was available, so only its call relationship is known.

name: return_shifted_offsets_when_nonzero
description: When any of three stored offset fields is non-zero, calls a routine and returns values derived from the structure, shifted by a count, as a 64-bit pair.

name: reset_entity_motion_state
description: Copies a flag byte from the second structure when its flag bit is set, adds a helper's pair of 32-bit values to accumulators in the first structure and clears three motion words.

name: scale_word_by_negated_operand
description: Multiplies a signed word by a shifted negated operand, doubles or negates the product by sign, and shifts the 64-bit result left by a count clamped to four.

name: scale_fields_with_clamped_shift
description: Multiplies three stored words by a signed operand split into high and low halves, then shifts the 64-bit result left by a count clamped to four and returns it.

name: normalize_multiply_matrix_row
description: Counts the right shifts needed to bring an operand below 16384, shifts another operand by that count and returns a dot product with the structure's matrix row.

name: multiply_vector_by_matrix
description: Computes two output words as dot products of three input words with rows of a stored matrix, shifting each result right and returning both as a 64-bit pair.

name: clamp_position_and_store
description: Clamps two input values to minimum and maximum limits stored in the structure, then stores them with a third input value as three words.

name: clamp_second_axis_and_store
description: Raises the first input to a minimum value, clamps the second input to structure limits and stores the three values as words.

name: clamp_two_axes_and_store
description: Clamps the second and third inputs to limits from the structure and stores the three values as words.

name: clamp_third_axis_and_store
description: Raises the second input to a minimum value, clamps the third input to structure limits and stores the three values as words.

name: clamp_third_value_and_store
description: Clamps the third input to limits from the structure and stores the three input values as words.

name: raise_third_value_and_store
description: Raises the third input to a minimum value taken from the structure and stores the three input values as words.

name: store_three_words_directly
description: Stores three input words into the structure at fixed offsets without clamping.

name: accumulate_scaled_motion_values
description: Scales an input by normalizing it to a 16-bit range, multiplies it with the structure's motion words and adds the 64-bit products into accumulator fields, calling one helper.

name: accumulate_scaled_motion_pair
description: Normalizes an input to a 16-bit range and accumulates scaled products into two pairs of structure accumulators with carry propagation, calling helpers along the way.

name: add_clamped_offset_with_carry
description: Adds a 32-bit input to an accumulator word and adds two 32-bit values to wider accumulators with carry, storing the result only when an overflow check passes.

name: add_offset_pair_with_carry
description: Adds a 16-bit input to a stored word and adds two 32-bit values to wider accumulators with carry, storing the result only when an overflow check passes.

name: clamp_and_add_value
description: Clamps an input value to a minimum threshold, adds it to a second value and stores the sum with two other values in the structure, provided the addition does not overflow.

name: shift_and_add_to_accumulators
description: Shifts three inputs right by a count, clamps each against a stored bound and adds the results to three 32-bit accumulators in the structure.

name: clamp_and_accumulate_axis_pair
description: Clamps two inputs against stored limits, zeroing a value when its sign differs from the limit, and adds them to two 32-bit accumulators in the structure.

name: clamp_and_accumulate_second_pair
description: Clamps an input against a stored limit, zeroing it on sign mismatch, and adds it and a second clamped input to two 32-bit accumulators.

name: clamp_and_accumulate_third_pair
description: Clamps two inputs against stored limits with sign-mismatch zeroing and adds them to two 32-bit accumulators in the structure, provided the addition does not overflow.

name: accumulate_clamped_value_with_check
description: Clamps a value against a stored limit, then adds it to 32-bit accumulators in the structure when the additions pass overflow checks.

name: add_inputs_to_accumulators_checked
description: Adds two inputs and a clamped third value to 32-bit accumulators in the structure, storing them only when no overflow occurs.

name: add_three_values_checked
description: Adds three input values to 32-bit accumulators in the structure, storing the sums only when none of the additions overflows.

name: accumulate_gated_motion_values
description: Returns zero when a state byte is clear; otherwise it calls a helper, reads several 32-bit values and adds scaled differences into the structure's accumulators, returning the first value.

name: normalize_and_accumulate_scaled_products
description: Shifts an input right until it fits 16383 or less, stores the shifted words in state when a flag is set and adds scaled products into the structure's accumulators.

name: accumulate_scaled_inputs_by_factor
description: Normalizes a scale factor to 15 bits, multiplies three inputs by it and adds the shifted products to the structure's accumulators with carry.

name: shift_and_accumulate
description: Right-shifts three input values by a count when a threshold check holds, then adds them to the three accumulators in the structure.

name: copy_flag_and_accumulate_differences
description: Copies a state byte from the second structure, adds corresponding 32-bit fields of both structures into accumulators and calls one routine.

name: subtract_entity_position
description: Stores a state byte, then subtracts the corresponding 32-bit fields of the second structure from the first structure's position fields, calling a routine before and after the adjustment.

name: scan_table_backward_for_flag
description: Scans a table backward from its last entry for an entry with a flag bit set, then calls a routine and stores two 32-bit values into the structure.

name: compute_scaled_entity_state
description: Returns when a flag byte is set; otherwise it computes a scaled timing value from a state byte and a second structure's word, makes several helper calls and stores three 32-bit results in the structure.

name: find_minimum_scaled_entry
description: Loops over table entries whose byte matches the input, computes a scaled difference of a word and keeps the smaller value, calling helpers along the way.

name: copy_flag_sum_structure_fields
description: Copies a state byte from the second structure, adds 32-bit fields from both structures into accumulators and calls one routine.

name: call_copy_flag_sum_fields
description: Calls one routine, then copies a state byte from the second structure, adds 32-bit fields from both structures into accumulators and calls another routine.

name: clear_flag_and_scan_table
description: Clears bit one of a global status byte and, when that bit was previously clear, scans a table backward for entries with a flag bit clear and writes sentinel values into their fields.

name: pass_selected_word_quad
description: Loads four 16-bit words from one of two stored sets, chosen by a flag byte, and passes them to a routine.

name: copy_matrix_to_buffer
description: Copies a block of words from the structure into a buffer, sets zero and fixed constants 512 and 176 at specific buffer offsets, and calls a routine.

name: transform_object_matrix
description: Decrements a countdown for a cached object matrix, refreshes the matrix through helper calls when it expires and returns a packed value shifted from the transformed result.

name: copy_state_with_offset_deltas
description: Calls a helper, computes differences between a structure's 32-bit fields and stored values and writes the results into global state fields, calling a helper when a type word equals 32.

name: walk_entity_chain_and_copy
description: Walks a chain of linked objects while each object's flag bit is clear, calls helpers, then stores three 32-bit values into a global block.

name: load_table_into_buffer
description: Scales an input down into range, stores three word values into a buffer and loads 32-bit values from a global table indexed by a byte field.

name: process_flagged_table_entries
description: Sets bit one of a status byte, then scans a table backward for entries with bit eight set, calling helper routines for each one until the index underflows.

name: reset_entries_or_call_helper
description: Loops over entries; when a byte matches the state value it writes sentinel values into the entry, otherwise it calls a helper, and stores a word into the structure before continuing.

name: fill_sentinels_and_scan_bits
description: Writes sentinel values into entries and scans a byte table for matching bits, calling a helper while the table has entries left.

name: scan_bits_and_decrement_counter
description: Scans a byte table backward for entries with bit eight set, calls a helper for each match and decrements a counter byte.

name: process_object_flags
description: Stores a word parameter into a global variable, then scans a byte table backward, calling a helper for each entry whose bit is set, and repeats from the start while a counter byte is zero, otherwise decrementing it.

name: set_entry_word_from_table
description: Looks up a table entry for the object, clears a flag bit in the structure, sets a word to 190 and calls a helper.

name: update_entry_flags_and_value
description: Clears flag bits eight and sixteen in the structure according to a stored flag, updates a table-derived value, sets a word to 190 and calls a helper.

name: load_table_pair_set_word
description: Clears a flag bit in the structure, loads two words from a table at the current index, computes a value and sets a word to 190 before calling a helper.

name: clear_counter_byte
description: Clears a counter byte in the structure.

name: scan_nonzero_reset_word
description: Resets a state word to zero, then scans a byte table backward, skipping zero entries and calling helpers for entries with a particular bit set.

name: iterate_and_call_handler
description: Scans a byte table backward and, for each entry whose bit five is clear, calls a helper and then a function pointer held in a register.

name: check_bounds_and_call
description: Scans a byte table backward, skipping entries with bit three set, and calls a function pointer for entries whose bit five is clear or whose stored values pass a bounds check.

name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Stores a table pointer, scans a byte table backward for entries with bit zero set, calls a helper for each match and decrements a counter byte in the structure.

name: process_bit_one_entries
description: Clears bit one of a global flag byte, then scans a byte table backward and, for each entry with bit one set, calls a helper and a function pointer selected by a byte value.

name: write_byte_to_indirect
description: Computes an address from a stored pointer and a byte field of the structure, then writes the input byte there.

name: find_flagged_entry_and_store
description: Scans a table backward for the first entry with bit five set and, when found at a non-zero index, stores the index into a state word and calls a helper.

name: find_unflagged_entry_index
description: Scans a table backward for the first entry whose bit five is clear, returning its index, or the default value when none is found.

name: store_byte_and_adjust_count
description: Stores the input byte into a buffer at the given index, adjusts a counter word depending on bit five, and sets a status byte by combining a nibble with a flag byte.

name: copy_entity_structure
description: Copies the fields of one structure into another field by field, then clears a flag byte in the destination and applies a threshold check to a stored value.

name: find_zero_slot_in_table
description: Scans a byte table backward for a zero entry, restarting from the top of the table when none is found at index twenty or above, and initialises the slot it finds.

name: find_zero_entry_restart
description: Scans a byte table backward for the first zero entry and, when none is found or the index is zero, restarts the scan from the top and calls helpers.

name: return_from_routine
description: Single return with no work; only the return instruction is present.

name: return_immediately
description: Single return that exits at once without touching data or hardware.

name: skip_empty_routine
description: Four-instruction stub whose decompiled body is only a return; it performs no observable work.

name: return_without_work
description: Single return that does nothing and is called from seven places.
